mughal-album.grammar: hairline brushwork and jewel-bright opaque color; profile figures mounted inside floral album borders

mithila.grammar: double outlines and hatched color fills pack every inch; no empty space anywhere

rinpa.grammar: gold-leaf grounds, bold silhouettes of plum and waves, tarashikomi pigment pooled into soft edges

chinese-ink-landscape.grammar: empty mist is active space; textured brush strokes build mountains around a tiny human guest

chaekgeori.grammar: books, brushes and ceramics stacked on shelves in neat rows, rendered near trompe-l'œil

kalighat.grammar: sweeping single-stroke outlines, flat washes, a few confident shadows model the figure

wayang-kulit.grammar: strict profile silhouette of perforated, gilded leather; jointed rods; shadow cast on a screen

ajanta-murals.grammar: soft shaded bodies without harsh outline; warm earth pigments melt out of dark cave ground

rajput-miniature.grammar: flat hot color and hair-thin detail; profile lovers on terraces beneath monsoon storm clouds

tibetan-thangka.grammar: calm central deity in perfect symmetry, ringed by clouds, mountains and ranked attendant figures

chola-bronze.grammar: dark polished lost-wax bronze; tribhanga triple-bend pose inside a ring of flame

pattachitra.grammar: bold outlines and flat color fields on a blazing red ground; dense mythological crowd

warli.grammar: white rice-paste figures built from two joined triangles; spirals and rows of dancers

gond.grammar: figures built entirely from tiny dots and dashes; saturated color glowing against dark grounds

tanjore.grammar: frontal icon-like figure on a wooden panel, dressed in real gold foil and glass beads

kalamkari.grammar: bamboo-pen line in plant and mineral dyes; epic story told across bordered narrative panels

company-painting.grammar: precise watercolor naturalism; subject arranged like a catalogue specimen with its tools around it

bengal-school.grammar: misty wash technique; figures dissolve into foggy muted color with no hard contour

khmer-relief.grammar: shallow sandstone carving covering whole walls; apsara dancers twist among dense mythic crowds

thai-temple-mural.grammar: flat perspective in black lacquer and gold; every inch teems with palaces and episodes

balinese-kamasan.grammar: puppet-like ringgit profile figures; separate episodes divided by flames, trees and rocks

dong-ho-prints.grammar: bold outlines and natural colors on shell-coated pearly paper; cheerful auspicious New Year motifs

vietnamese-lacquer.grammar: layered red, black and gold lacquer with eggshell inlay; image glows out of darkness

chinese-calligraphy.grammar: one sweeping brush gesture carries speed, pressure and breath; the silhouette is suggested, not drawn

gongbi.grammar: fine ink outlines on silk filled with thin mineral-color layers; patient, exact, luxurious detail

literati-painting.grammar: dry, scratchy brushstrokes and vast emptiness of silk; a tiny figure lost in landscape

dunhuang-murals.grammar: brilliant mineral blue and green; weightless apsaras with streaming ribbons on cracked plaster

chinese-bronzes.grammar: green-patinated bronze vessels covered in taotie animal-mask faces and swirling relief patterns

shanghai-school.grammar: loosened, splashier brushwork and brighter color turned onto modern city-life subjects

lingnan-school.grammar: Chinese ink fused with Western watercolor light; figures washed in luminous atmospheric color

contemporary-ink.grammar: huge abstract ink fields, pours and digital glitches surround one small standing figure

yamato-e.grammar: blown-off-roof view into palace rooms from above; gold cloud bands separate the episodes

kano-screens.grammar: bold pine, hawk and tiger silhouettes painted against grounds of pure gold leaf

zen-ink.grammar: one-breath uncorrected strokes; the ensō circle left slightly open; figure surrounded by white silence

nihonga.grammar: ground mineral pigments and gold leaf on silk; soft graded washes, glowing flat color

nanga.grammar: loose, playful ink landscape; a recluse in a mountain hut among sketchy peaks

sosaku-hanga.grammar: bold expressive gouge marks left proudly visible; one artist draws, carves and prints alone

mingei.grammar: rustic handmade stoneware and indigo textiles; honest materials, beauty found in use and imperfection

minhwa.grammar: flat bright color and bold simple shapes; a foolish tiger paired with a clever magpie

true-view-landscape.grammar: bold slashing brushwork on real, recognizable granite peaks; a tiny walker on the path below

goryeo-buddhist.grammar: hair-fine lines on silk dusted with gold powder; serene water-moon Kannon composition

dansaekhwa.grammar: single-color paint pushed, dragged and soaked into canvas; the figure barely emerges from the field

pictorialist-photography.grammar: soft focus, diffused highlights, hand-worked prints — painterly haze dissolves hard edges

documentary-photography.grammar: grain, available light, unposed instant, full tonal range — the scene recorded without staging

photorealism.grammar: photographic blur, glare and cropping transferred exactly into paint, detail rendered uniformly

trompe-loeil.grammar: true scale, cast shadows, painted ledges and frames — objects project illusionistically toward the viewer

daguerreotype.grammar: mirror-bright silvered plate, long-exposure stillness; image tilts between positive and negative

wet-plate.grammar: deep blacks, streaked edges, chemical stains and vignetting from hand-coated collodion plates

straight-photography.grammar: tack-sharp focus throughout, full black-to-white tonal scale, no manipulation

street-photography.grammar: candid gesture and layered depth, geometry caught at one unrepeatable instant

photogram.grammar: camera-less white silhouettes on a black ground — objects recorded by the light they block

hyperrealism.grammar: detail sharpened beyond the photograph — every pore, thread and reflection at equal intensity

illusionistic-ceiling.grammar: painted architecture continues the real building upward; extreme foreshortening for viewers far below

anamorphosis.grammar: image stretched diagonally into incoherence; resolves only from one oblique viewpoint or curved mirror

color-photography.grammar: saturated dye-transfer color, ordinary subjects, democratic framing — everything given equal attention

staged-photography.grammar: constructed set, directed actor, cinematic lighting — every element placed before the exposure

dusseldorf-school.grammar: frontal deadpan framing in flat even light; identical subjects arranged as typological series

fashion-photography.grammar: sculptural pose, dramatic directional light, garment silhouette emphasized against a styled backdrop

double-exposure.grammar: two exposures layered in one frame; translucent forms ghost through each other

byzantine-mosaic.grammar: small stone and glass tesserae on a gold ground; flattened frontal figures glow in flickering light

stained-glass.grammar: pieces of colored glass joined by lead cames; image read by transmitted light, black outlines everywhere

paper-collage.grammar: flat cut-paper shapes with scissor edges, overlapping planes, no modeling or shading

batik.grammar: wax-resist outlines and crackle veins where dye bleeds through; colors built in successive dye baths

narrative-story-quilts.grammar: appliquéd cloth shapes with seam outlines; patterned fabrics supply the shading, scenes stitched in registers

carved-relief.grammar: figures project a few centimeters from a flat stone ground; raking light and depth alone model form

ceramic-vessel.grammar: painted scene wraps a curved glazed belly; colors transform in the kiln, glossy finish reflects light

tapestry.grammar: woven wool blocks flatten forms into stepped outlines; millefleurs pattern fills every background gap

embroidery.grammar: couched wool threads on linen; flat outlined figures, borders lively with animals above and below

persian-carpet.grammar: knotted pile; central medallion, corner spandrels and layered borders organize the field symmetrically

islamic-tilework.grammar: hand-cut glazed tiles in cobalt and turquoise; interlocking stars and polygons fitted without gaps

lacquerware.grammar: gold powder sprinkled into black lacquer; mother-of-pearl inlay glows against the deep polished ground

cloisonne.grammar: bent metal wires partition the surface; each cell filled with a single jewel-bright enamel color

papercutting.grammar: one connected silhouette cut from a single sheet — the picture formed by what is removed

freestanding-sculpture.grammar: fully three-dimensional figure on a plinth, meant to be circled; the material surface carries the modeling

pietra-dura.grammar: shapes cut from differently colored stones, fitted seam-tight and polished into one picture plane

blown-glass.grammar: translucent blown forms; light passes through the material, softening edges and glowing from within

beadwork.grammar: thousands of seed beads stitched in rows; the image resolves at distance, dissolves into units up close

basketry.grammar: coiled fiber spirals climb round on round; the spiral stitch structure is itself the visible pattern

featherwork.grammar: individual feathers glued in overlapping mosaic rows; iridescent color shifts as the viewer moves

goldwork.grammar: stiff gold threads couched over padding on silk; raised metallic relief catches light on a deep ground

ivory-carving.grammar: miniature figure carved in creamy fine-grained ivory; jeweler-scale detail, warm polished surface

paper-marbling.grammar: pigment floated on water, combed into feathered swirls, transferred to paper in a single contact

azulejo.grammar: hand-painted blue-and-white tiles in a grid; grout lines break the scene and rejoin it

egyptian-wall-painting.grammar: composite figure — profile head, frontal eye and shoulders, profile legs; registers and hieratic scale

greek-vase-painting.grammar: black silhouettes with incised detail, later red figures reserved against a glossy black ground

medieval-illumination.grammar: gold-leaf miniatures inside decorated initials; margins filled with vines, beasts and drolleries

persian-manuscript.grammar: jewel colors, gold sky, architecture cut open like a dollhouse; space stacks in tiers, not recession

cave-painting.grammar: earth pigments blown or smeared on bare rock; no ground line, animals overlap in flickering outline

saharan-rock-art.grammar: elongated, weightless figures in sun-baked ochres painted directly on open sandstone faces

mesopotamian.grammar: strict profile processions in carved registers; glazed blue brick with molded animal reliefs

cycladic.grammar: white marble figure reduced to smooth planes; folded arms, tilted-back head, all detail smoothed away

minoan-fresco.grammar: flowing curved figures with pinched waists and long curls in earthy reds, blues and yellows

etruscan-tomb.grammar: flat cheerful colors and dark outlines; patterned borders frame banquets, dancers and musicians

greek-sculpture.grammar: contrapposto — weight on one leg, hips and shoulders counter-tilted; ideal calm proportions in marble

roman-wall-painting.grammar: painted fake architecture and garden views on rich red grounds — illusionistic windows in real walls

roman-mosaic.grammar: thousands of stone tesserae; the image resolves at distance, framed by black-and-white braided borders

achaemenid-relief.grammar: endless profile lines of tribute-bearers climb palace stairs; costume and gift identify each nation

fayum-portraits.grammar: encaustic wax paint on wood panels; huge dark eyes, individualized faces, gold wreaths

catacomb-painting.grammar: simple faded fresco symbols — fish, anchor, dove — and praying figures with raised arms

byzantine-icon.grammar: gold ground, flat frontal figure, inverse perspective opening toward the viewer; no natural light source

carolingian-ottonian.grammar: enthroned wide-eyed figures in jeweled gold frames; flat hieratic bodies, drapery as decorative pattern

insular.grammar: interlace knotwork, spirals and self-biting beasts fill the page; letters dissolve into ornament mazes

romanesque.grammar: squat carved figures bent to fit the tympanum; drapery drawn in rhythmic parallel lines

gothic.grammar: S-curved swaying figures, jewel-bright color, gold grounds tooled with punched patterns

russian-icon.grammar: elongated weightless figures; thin gold assiste lines sparkle on robes, faces luminous and calm

ethiopian-painting.grammar: enormous almond-shaped eyes, flat reds, ochres and greens; saints arranged in rows on church walls

armenian-manuscripts.grammar: intense mineral blues and reds; canon tables under horseshoe arches, margins dense with birds and flowers

islamic-calligraphy.grammar: flowing thuluth letterforms stretch, stack and interlace until the words themselves form the image

arabesque.grammar: endless scrolling tendrils interwoven with exact star-and-polygon geometry; no beginning, center or edge

ottoman-miniature.grammar: flattened bird's-eye view; tiny bright figures act in tiled courtyards — no shadows, no single viewpoint

qajar-painting.grammar: frontal court portraits, joined arched brows and huge eyes; jeweled crowns against flat decorative grounds

renaissance-perspective.grammar: single vanishing point, receding floor grid, measured architecture framing figures in rational space

baroque.grammar: strong diagonals, deep shadow against sudden light, figures caught mid-gesture

neoclassicism.grammar: clean contour lines, smooth marble surfaces, frieze-like arrangements of upright figures

rococo.grammar: pastel palette, S-curves and shell scrolls, feathery foliage, figures in playful garden groupings

romanticism.grammar: tiny lone figure before vast fog, storms and ruins; turbulent skies, dramatic scale contrast

pre-raphaelite.grammar: jewel-bright color, sharp-focus detail in every leaf, literary figures in real observed landscapes

tonalism.grammar: single dominant hue, soft edges, forms dissolving into dusk mist, minimal detail

dutch-vanitas.grammar: carefully lit tabletop objects — skulls, hourglasses, wilting flowers — arranged as symbols of brevity

french-realism.grammar: life-size ordinary workers, earthy palette, unidealized bodies in contemporary dress and settings

proto-renaissance.grammar: solid weighty figures on a shallow stage, gold accents fading, faces showing real grief and wonder

early-netherlandish.grammar: microscopic oil-painted detail, jewel light, mirrors and small symbolic objects placed throughout

northern-renaissance.grammar: crowded panoramas of small figures, precise engraved line, proverbs and seasons teeming across landscape

high-renaissance.grammar: pyramidal balanced groupings, smoky sfumato edges, serene faces, calm harmonious proportions

venetian-colorism.grammar: layered golden glazes, color modeling flesh and silk, warm atmospheric light over line

mannerism.grammar: elongated twisted bodies, serpentine poses, acid colors, crowded vertical compressed space

dutch-golden-age.grammar: window daylight in quiet interiors or golden shadow; small domestic scenes precisely observed

spanish-golden-age.grammar: loose effortless brushwork, dark court interiors, mirrors and glances engaging the viewer

french-classicism.grammar: frieze-like figure arrangement, measured golden landscape, every element placed in rational order

goya.grammar: bright festive tapestry color colliding with black nightmare imagery, etched shadows, raw expressive faces

english-landscape.grammar: towering studied clouds, fresh oil-sketch brushwork, small figures inside green valley weather

hudson-river-school.grammar: vast glowing valleys, waterfalls and peaks in sharp detail, tiny humbled human figures

barbizon.grammar: quiet tonal browns and greens, forest edges at dusk, peasants given monumental still dignity

academic-art.grammar: porcelain skin, invisible brushstrokes, marble-smooth mythological figures in polished finish

american-realism.grammar: anatomically exact bodies, clear Atlantic light, rowers and workers observed without flattery

vedute.grammar: crystalline architectural panorama, exact cornices and ripples, tiny figures inside a painted postcard

grand-manner.grammar: sitters in classical silk and columns, feathery trees, elevated poses borrowed from antiquity

chardin.grammar: soft grey-brown light, velvety paint, humble pots and servants held in silent stillness

orientalism.grammar: jewel-precise tiles and textiles, tiled palaces and markets, imagined Eastern interiors richly detailed

nazarenes.grammar: clean outlines, bright local color, fresco-like solemn processions, early-Renaissance clarity revived

luminism.grammar: invisible brushwork, glassy mirror water, calm supernatural light at dawn or dusk

macchiaioli.grammar: bold patches of color side by side, form dissolved into spots of sunlight and shade

peredvizhniki.grammar: honest social scenes, processions and laborers, piercing psychological faces in observed Russian settings

naturalism.grammar: photographic accuracy outdoors, high-key bright daylight, peasants in fields with every blade told

japonisme.grammar: flat color areas, daring cropped compositions, diagonal bridges borrowed from ukiyo-e prints

mexican-muralism.grammar: architectural-scale registers of history and labor, monumental figures readable from across a plaza

harlem-renaissance.grammar: flat silhouetted forms, radiating light beams, African motifs and jazz-age rhythmic patterning

american-regionalism.grammar: rolling farmland curves, small-town clarity, rhythmic rounded forms in crisp tempera-like finish

soviet-socialist-realism.grammar: idealized sunlit workers and engineers, heroic poses, academic realism in service of optimism

new-objectivity.grammar: crystalline precise detail, cold ironic portraits and café scenes, nothing exaggerated

arts-and-crafts.grammar: visible handwork, honest materials, medieval-revival pattern covering walls, textiles and furniture

ashcan-school.grammar: dark charcoal-heavy city scenes, tenements and crowds painted with raw gestural energy

social-realism.grammar: flat tempera panels, plain legible figures, episodes of migration and work in sequence

new-deal-art.grammar: monumental sturdy workers building dams and bridges, optimistic clear forms for public walls

propaganda-poster.grammar: bold limited colors, one unforgettable pointing figure, slogan readable across a street, halftone grain

graffiti-street-art.grammar: stenciled portraits and wildstyle lettering on brick, spray drips, block-scale public imagery

chicano-muralism.grammar: neighborhood wall murals, Aztec calendars and heroes, airbrushed lowrider colors, community history lessons

feminist-art.grammar: embroidery and ceramics raised to monument scale, place settings honoring women's lives and labor

black-arts-movement.grammar: radiant Kool-Aid poster colors, murals of heroes and families, proud joyful community imagery

chinese-revolutionary-poster.grammar: rosy-cheeked model workers in heroic poses, red sun rays, smooth gouache finish

cuban-ospaaal.grammar: Day-Glo silkscreen inks, fighters flowers and flags fused into one flat unforgettable symbol

polish-poster-school.grammar: one surreal painted metaphor in loose gouache, minimal type, poetic image carrying whole film

may-68-posters.grammar: one color, one bold silkscreened image, few words, rough fast printing for street walls

taller-grafica.grammar: stark black-and-white linocut broadsides, bold carved shapes, cheap prints pasted on walls

group-of-seven.grammar: windswept jack pines, pink granite and cold lakes, vigorous weather-beaten outdoor sketch brushwork

heidelberg-school.grammar: blue distances and golden heat-hazed air, bush landscapes painted fast outdoors, settler work scenes

brazilian-modernism.grammar: bulbous green hills, giant playful dreamlike figures, European forms digested into Brazilian shapes

indigenismo.grammar: monumental Indigenous figures in earth colors, terraced landscapes, dignity of labor and heritage

nigerian-modernism.grammar: curving uli line work flowing through modern oil painting, traditional forms fused with contemporary scenes

american-comic-book.grammar: bold black ink outlines and flat heroic color; shading built from visible Ben-Day dots inside panel borders

ligne-claire.grammar: every object outlined in the same even black line, filled with flat color; no hatching or cast shadows

caricature.grammar: the face's most telling features stretched and enlarged; likeness carried by exaggeration rather than detail

golden-age-illustration.grammar: lush gilt-edged plates with intricate ink detail and romantic, storybook framing

picture-book.grammar: soft gouache shapes and an uncluttered composition, with calm open space left where the text would go

botanical-illustration.grammar: measured, exact line; specimens dissected, arranged and labeled so a reader can identify the real thing

fashion-illustration.grammar: an elongated, nine-heads-tall croquis figure drawn in flowing ink lines with touches of gold

underground-comix.grammar: dense, sweating cross-hatch; forms bulge and wobble with unruly hand-drawn energy

pulp-cover.grammar: lurid painted scene of peril with a dramatic heroine pose and wide empty space at top for the title

technical-drawing.grammar: exact elevations with dimension lines and standard symbols; white line on deep blueprint blue

tattoo-flash.grammar: bold black outlines and a tight palette of red, green and ochre; ready-made designs pinned on one sheet

irezumi.grammar: dragons, koi, waves and peonies flow continuously across the body, with open skin left as breathing space

concept-art.grammar: pages of quick painted thumbnails and variations, with annotated callouts pointing at design details

pixel-art.grammar: every pixel placed on purpose; limited palettes, readable silhouettes, dithering used for gradients

nes-8bit.grammar: chunky pixels, flat color and hard outlines; each sprite allowed only a few colors from a 54-color palette

snes-16bit.grammar: finer pixels and thousands of colors allow real shading, dusk light and glow effects

ps1-2d.grammar: high-resolution hand-drawn sprites over painted, pre-rendered backgrounds with a faint CRT softness

ps1-3d-lowpoly.grammar: a few hundred polygons per character, flat Gouraud shading, textures that swim and warp

ps1-3d-refined.grammar: multiplied polygons, rounded joints and texture-mapped faces; still low-resolution and slightly wobbly

ps3-ps4-3d.grammar: high-polygon models, normal maps faking fine detail, soft shadows and cinematic depth of field

ps5-raytraced.grammar: light itself simulated: true reflections, soft global illumination, skin that scatters light

stylized-3d.grammar: 3D forms with painted, non-photorealistic surfaces; soft studio light and smooth materials

vector-arcade.grammar: everything drawn as glowing wireframe lines on black; no filled shapes at all

game-boy.grammar: chunky pixels in exactly four shades of green on a tiny low-resolution screen

isometric.grammar: the world tilted at a fixed diamond angle; rooms read as floating dollhouse dioramas of hand-placed tiles

prerendered-cg.grammar: glossy 3D models rendered in advance on workstations, then flattened into sprites with a plastic, airbrushed sheen

n64-3d.grammar: models built from few polygons, textures smeared into blur, distance fog hiding the short draw distance

ps2-era-3d.grammar: smooth, clean models with shiny reflective surfaces and the first modern lighting tricks

cel-shaded-3d.grammar: real 3D models rendered as cartoons: flat colors, simple shadow bands and bold outlines

voxel.grammar: the whole world built from tiny cubes; every object, cup included, becomes blocky sculpture

ascii-1bit.grammar: pictures built only from keyboard characters in two colors; shading is just denser typing

modern-lowpoly-indie.grammar: big flat-shaded facets, soft pastel colors and gentle fog; low polygon counts chosen on purpose

hand-painted-textures.grammar: 3D models wrapped in textures painted brushstroke by brushstroke; the world reads as a walkable storybook illustration

hd-2d.grammar: pixel-art sprite characters wander 3D diorama sets; tilt-shift blur and glowing bloom make the miniature world precious

maya-painted-ceramics.grammar: calligraphic black line on cream slip, figures in profile, glyph blocks interleaved with palace scenes

ayacucho-retablo.grammar: tiered wooden box interior, rows of small painted figures acting out scenes behind opening doors

nok-terracotta.grammar: naturalistic fired-clay heads, stylized coiffure and jewelry, pierced pupils, matte red-brown surface

ife-bronze.grammar: flat bronze relief plaques in dark metal, court figures in regalia arranged in registers

african-masks.grammar: carved wooden faces of stylized planes, contrasting pale and dark patinas, geometric scarification marks

kuba-cloth.grammar: bold interlaced geometry on raffia, embroidered and cut-pile textures, improvisational breaks in the pattern

kente.grammar: narrow woven strips sewn edge to edge, alternating named pattern blocks in gold, green, red, black

ndebele-painting.grammar: huge crisp geometric murals, bold black outlines, flat saturated color blocks on whitewashed walls

adire.grammar: white resist-painted motifs floating on deep indigo, two-tone pattern fields, stenciled or hand-drawn repeats

uli-nsibidi.grammar: sweeping curvilinear black strokes on a white ground, figure reduced to calligraphy, ideogram signs alongside

asafo-flags.grammar: flat appliquéd cloth figures on a bold colored field, proverb scene, contrasting canton in one corner

tingatinga.grammar: glossy bicycle enamel on board, flat saturated color, oversized animals, no cast shadows

oshogbo.grammar: dense swirling crowds of spirits, animals and people, printmaking textures, layered translucent color

el-anatsui.grammar: thousands of linked bottle caps stitched into draping metal cloth, shimmering mosaic surface, folds and ripples

aboriginal-bark.grammar: ochre clan motifs on eucalyptus bark, forms infilled with fine rarrk cross-hatching that makes surfaces shimmer

western-desert-dot.grammar: aerial map view, concentric meeting-place circles joined by dotted travel lines, dot fields in desert colors

maori-carving.grammar: koru spirals unfurling across carved posts, red-black-white painted rafter patterns, deep relief carving

tapa-cloth.grammar: beaten bark sheets stamped with geometric motifs repeated in grids, earthy brown and black palette

sepik-carving.grammar: bold swirling faces and crocodiles carved in relief, picked out in ochre, white and black paint

rapa-nui.grammar: monumental stone heads with elongated torsos and minimal features, human figures dwarfed by their scale

hawaiian-featherwork.grammar: thousands of tiny red and yellow feathers tied to fiber netting, bold geometric crescents and triangles

olmec.grammar: colossal basalt heads with naturalistic features and helmet-like headdresses, monumental scale in jungle clearings

teotihuacan-murals.grammar: flat profile figures in procession against deep red walls, outlined forms, offerings of water and butterflies

aztec-codices.grammar: flat outline figures on deerskin pages, speech scrolls at mouths, day signs and place glyphs framing scenes

andean-textiles.grammar: woven figure set into a tocapu grid of geometric squares, alpaca-wool colors, embroidered surface detail

moche-ceramics.grammar: sculpted ceramic portrait heads, cream and red-brown palette, stirrup-shaped spout rising behind the head

northwest-coast-formline.grammar: swelling formlines, ovoids and U-forms in black, red and teal, creatures split across the surface

plains-ledger-art.grammar: flat lively figures in colored pencil on lined account-book paper, blue ledger lines showing through

pueblo-pottery.grammar: black-on-white painted bowl interior, figure at the center ringed by feather and stepped patterns

inuit-prints.grammar: bold simple shapes cut into stone and printed by hand, flat color, Arctic animals with radiant presence

navajo-weaving.grammar: upright-loom wool geometry, storm pattern linking a central rectangle to four corners with stepped lightning

woodlands-school.grammar: bold black outlines and bright flat color, X-ray lines revealing inner spirit, flowing lines joining beings

huichol-yarn.grammar: bright yarn strands pressed into beeswax, every contour a thread, deer, maize and peyote motifs throughout

amate.grammar: jewel-bright village scenes on brown bark paper, crowded fiestas, birds and flowers filling every gap

cuzco-school.grammar: flat patterned surfaces, robes stamped with gold brocade, Madonna-like figures with Andean birds and flowers

casta-painting.grammar: labeled panel scenes of colonial daily life, market settings, clothing and food rendered in careful detail

haitian-painting.grammar: flat brilliant color, lush Eden-like greenery, no shadows, crowded joyful market scenes

mola.grammar: stacked colored cloth cut through and stitched back, layered rainbow contours shared with fish and birds

graphite-drawing.grammar: everything modeled in gray value alone; soft blended shading, no color at all

pen-and-ink.grammar: grays faked by hatching and cross-hatching; crisp permanent black lines, no blending

ink-wash.grammar: diluted ink laid in flowing tonal washes; one brushstroke must carry a whole shadow

charcoal.grammar: deepest velvety blacks with smudged soft edges; tones lifted back out with an eraser

colored-pencil.grammar: color built from dozens of transparent layered strokes; fine controlled detail, visible paper grain

soft-pastel.grammar: nearly pure pigment with a powdery matte surface; soft edges, colors glow without gloss

watercolor.grammar: transparent washes where the paper's white becomes the light; edges bloom, pool and dry lighter

gouache.grammar: opaque matte color in flat, even, poster-like coverage with a chalky dried finish

acrylic-painting.grammar: fast-drying paint with crisp edges and a smooth satin surface; imitates oil or flat poster color

oil-painting.grammar: slow blended paint layered with translucent glazes; rich depth in skin, silk and shadow

egg-tempera.grammar: built from thousands of tiny hatched strokes; matte, pale and luminous early-Renaissance surface

buon-fresco.grammar: pigment locked into wet plaster; matte mineral color where surface cracks become part of the image

digital-painting.grammar: software brushes imitate any medium; perfect gradients and undo, no material texture unless added

vector-illustration.grammar: every shape is a mathematical curve; flat color, zero texture, scales forever without blurring

manga-ink.grammar: bold black ink plus screentone dot patterns faking gray; few tones, built for fast reading

anime-cel.grammar: flat color with exactly one shadow tone per shape; bold outlines and zero blending

red-chalk.grammar: warm rust-red monochrome flattering skin; soft fingertip blending like an Old Master life study

oil-pastel.grammar: thick waxy strokes of vivid color; rich, smeary surface that never fully dries

encaustic.grammar: pigment suspended in molten beeswax; luminous, slightly melted softness with a built-up surface

impasto.grammar: paint stands up in ridges and peaks; palette-knife marks turn the surface into low relief

grisaille.grammar: painted entirely in grays; with color switched off, value and form carry everything

spray-paint.grammar: aerosol fades beside stencil-sharp edges; overspray drift and bold, fast coverage

scratchboard.grammar: white lines scratched through solid black; the image is drawn with light instead of darkness

marker-rendering.grammar: fast, streaky transparent strokes layered into rich color; the design-studio concept-sketch look

ballpoint.grammar: rich tones built from one color of ink and patient hatched lines, one stroke at a time

casein.grammar: milk-protein paint drying fast to a chalky, completely matte and quietly old-fashioned flat finish

fresco-secco.grammar: paint on already-dry plaster; matte mineral color with cracks and stains showing through over time

cgi-render.grammar: scene calculated in 3D; simulated light bounce and through-skin glow, polished product-ad sheen

matte-painting.grammar: a painted backdrop composited behind a real foreground; vast scenery that was never built

woodblock.grammar: carved relief where what is not cut away prints black; bold shapes with visible knife marks

ukiyo-e.grammar: a separate carved block per color in perfect registration; flat color inside elegant contour lines

linocut.grammar: soft linoleum cuts into bold swinging curves; high-contrast, poster-like carved marks

copperplate-etching.grammar: acid-bitten lines hold ink in the plate's grooves; spiderweb delicacy beside deep, warm darks

lithography.grammar: greasy crayon drawn on stone preserves the exact feel of the stroke; soft tonal grain

screenprinting.grammar: each color pushed through its own stenciled screen; image arrives in flat, separable ink layers

cyanotype.grammar: iron salts and sunlight turn everything Prussian blue; white silhouettes and line work on blue

generative-plotter.grammar: an algorithm sets the rules and a pen plotter draws them; line density becomes the shading

engraving.grammar: burin-cut lines swell and taper with musical control; the image rebuilt entirely from disciplined lines

drypoint.grammar: the needle's ragged burr catches extra ink, so lines print fuzzy, velvety and sketchy

aquatint.grammar: draws with tones, not lines: resin dust bitten into thousands of pits printing as grainy gray washes

mezzotint.grammar: plate roughened to print solid black, then burnished smooth; light polished out of darkness, velvet-soft

wood-engraving.grammar: white lines cut into dense end-grain wood; incredibly fine detail for dramatic illustrated-book scenes

monotype.grammar: a painting on a smooth plate pressed to paper exactly once; soft, ghostly, one-chance painterly blur

chiaroscuro-woodcut.grammar: several blocks layer flat brown and ochre tones beneath the line block for modeled light and shadow

pochoir.grammar: gouache dabbed through dozens of hand-cut stencils; crisp, flat, jewel-bright decorative color

letterpress.grammar: raised type and image pressed so hard into paper you can feel the dent

halftone-offset.grammar: the image is secretly CMYK halftone dots; the eye mixes four inks into full color

risograph.grammar: soy-ink stencil layers printed separately and slightly off-register; fluorescent, grainy, DIY energy

shin-hanga.grammar: traditional woodblock carving and printing carrying Western light, shadow and atmosphere; quiet luminous scenes

chinese-new-year-prints.grammar: folk woodblock outlines finished with hand-painted color; festive red and gold luck symbolism

posada-calavera.grammar: bold black etched line for penny broadsheets; punchy images made to be read at a glance

impressionism.grammar: broken touches of unmixed color, no black; edges dissolve into shimmering light and atmosphere

pointillism.grammar: image built from thousands of separate dots of pure color, mixed by the eye at distance

symbolism.grammar: dreamlike staged scenes, jeweled detail, crescent moons and peacocks; mood suggested, never explained

fauvism.grammar: arbitrary high-chroma color in bold flat strokes; drawing simplified, feeling over description

expressionism.grammar: jagged contours, tilted space, acid color and slashing strokes distort the scene to match anxiety

cubism.grammar: object fractured into interlocking geometric planes; several viewpoints shown at once, palette near-monochrome

futurism.grammar: repeated limbs and motion echoes, force-lines and streaking light render speed itself

orphism.grammar: concentric discs and arcs of simultaneous contrasting color; rhythm replaces subject

surrealism.grammar: impossible objects rendered with photographic precision in dream landscapes; scale and logic quietly wrong

dada-photomontage.grammar: cut photographs and newsprint recombined into absurd satirical machines; visible seams, clashing scales

cezanne.grammar: world rebuilt from cylinders, spheres and cones; warm-cool patches of color construct form

van-gogh.grammar: thick directional impasto strokes and intensified complementary color make every surface vibrate

gauguin-synthetism.grammar: flat areas of pure color enclosed by dark cloisonné outlines; shading traded for symbolic feeling

toulouse-lautrec.grammar: flat silhouettes, daring crops and few acidic colors; crowd reduced to black shapes

les-nabis.grammar: domestic interior where pattern swallows depth; figure and wallpaper merge into one decorative surface

vienna-secession.grammar: figures wrapped in gold ornament of squares and spirals, or drawn with raw nervous contour

blaue-reiter.grammar: prismatic color, blue dominant, forms dissolving toward abstraction; animals and mountains as spiritual symbols

naive-art.grammar: flat lush foliage, no perspective, every leaf counted; dream scene painted with earnest precision

suprematism.grammar: single geometric forms — black square, red rectangle — floating on white; painting reduced to pure feeling

early-abstraction.grammar: spirals, shells and symbolic diagrams in soft pastel map invisible spiritual evolution

metaphysical-painting.grammar: empty piazzas, long raking shadows, arcades and statues; mannequin figures in impossible light

school-of-paris.grammar: floating lovers over village rooftops; elongated elegant necks; cosmopolitan Paris modernism

dada-readymade.grammar: an ordinary manufactured object on a gallery plinth, declared art by the artist's choice alone

abstract-surrealism.grammar: private sign-language of stars, birds and ladders scattered like constellations on deep blue

kahlo.grammar: frontal unflinching self-portrait framed by jungle growth, monkeys and a folk ex-voto border

art-brut.grammar: dense marker-and-crayon field with no empty space; faces repeat obsessively, horror vacui

vorticism.grammar: hard angles and crystalline shards; figure as faceted engine at the still center of a vortex

rayonism.grammar: figure refracted into crossed beams of spectral color; objects dissolve into rays of light

cubo-futurism.grammar: metallic cones and cylinders shatter the figure amid the chaos of an experimental book page

purism.grammar: tubular robot-like figures in bold outline and flat primaries; painting ordered like a machine

synchromism.grammar: rhythmic arcs of spectral color build form the way notes build musical scales and chords

magic-realism.grammar: everyday scene painted with perfect clarity while one impossible thing happens, very quietly

cobra.grammar: fierce joyful figures in raw bright paint; childlike and folk spontaneity valued over polish

art-informel.grammar: form abandoned for gesture and matter; thick dragged paint, stains and smears, figure barely surfacing

school-of-london.grammar: fleshy paint and psychological pressure; the figure exposed inside a space-frame cage

art-nouveau.grammar: whiplash line turns hair, stems and smoke into one flowing ornamental system

art-deco.grammar: sunbursts, chevrons and symmetry; gold on black; curves disciplined into geometry

bauhaus.grammar: world rebuilt from circle, triangle, square in red, yellow, blue; typographic grids

constructivism.grammar: bold diagonals, red-black-cream photomontage; figures thrust forward like pistons

de-stijl.grammar: black lines, white ground, red-yellow-blue rectangles only; the figure survives as grid

op-art.grammar: stripes that bend, grids that swell, moiré that hums; the figure appears as a shift in pattern

abstract-expressionism.grammar: dripped webs, slashed brushstrokes or glowing color fields; painting as physical event at large scale

minimalism.grammar: almost everything removed; one figure, immense quiet, space itself doing the talking

swiss-style.grammar: grids, sans-serif type, asymmetry and red-black-white order; words replaced by pure shapes

precisionism.grammar: factories painted like cathedrals: immaculate geometry, sharp light, no people, no dirt

color-field.grammar: thinned paint soaked into raw canvas; a huge glowing expanse of color is the whole subject

hard-edge.grammar: flat unmixed color shapes with razor-sharp borders arranged like puzzle pieces

neo-concrete.grammar: hinged metal forms to fold by hand; sewn capes that become art only when danced in

plakatstil.grammar: one bold simplified product huge on an empty ground; no scenery, no story

streamline-moderne.grammar: long horizontal lines and rounded chrome corners; even parked buildings look fast

mid-century-modern.grammar: clean lines, warm wood, molded plywood and starburst patterns in mustard and teal

new-wave-type.grammar: letters torn, layered, stretched and half-buried; reading becomes experience, not just information

flat-vs-skeuomorphic.grammar: one half dressed as real leather, glass and felt; the other plain colored shapes

isotype.grammar: one simple icon stands for a set number of things; more icons mean more of them

wiener-werkstatte.grammar: black-and-white grids and checkerboards unify furniture, fabric, jewelry and cutlery as total artwork

japanese-postwar-graphics.grammar: rising suns, Mount Fuji and ukiyo-e waves collide with psychedelic pop color and photography

classical-orders.grammar: kit of column styles — Doric, Ionic, Corinthian — each under strict rules of proportion

gothic-cathedral.grammar: pointed arches, ribbed vaults and rose windows; stone walls thinned into cages of colored light

muqarnas.grammar: hundreds of small carved cells stack into a honeycomb dome dissolving wall into ceiling

baroque-architecture.grammar: curving walls, oval domes and staged shafts of light; architecture as emotional performance

beaux-arts.grammar: strict symmetry, sweeping staircases, every surface dressed with sculpture and gilding

international-style.grammar: white glass-and-steel boxes on stilts, ribbon windows, no ornament, no history

organic-architecture.grammar: concrete terraces pour over a waterfall; stone, glass and forest composed as one

postmodern-architecture.grammar: broken pediments, polka-dot columns and tops copied from antique furniture; ornament with a wink

high-tech-architecture.grammar: ducts, pipes and escalators moved outside, color-coded and displayed like a cheerful machine

metabolism.grammar: prefabricated room-capsules bolted onto a concrete core, each swappable like a living cell

parametric-architecture.grammar: algorithms generate seamless curves; walls melt into floors, the right angle nearly disappears

pop-art.grammar: enlarged advertising and comic imagery, Ben-Day dots, flat commercial color, silkscreen repetition of portraits

psychedelic-poster.grammar: melting Art Nouveau lettering, liquid swirling forms, vibrating complementary colors, legibility sacrificed to sensation

memphis-design.grammar: squiggles, terrazzo chips, pastel-and-black clashes, playful geometric shapes refusing symmetry or good taste

space-age-design.grammar: starbursts, boomerang shapes, orbital rings, glossy white and orange, rounded rocket-age forms

afrofuturism.grammar: African motifs and regal gold projected into starfields, cosmic technology and advanced cities

neo-dada.grammar: everyday found objects and photographs combined deadpan with painting, targets and flags as ready-made imagery

nouveau-realisme.grammar: reality used as material: monochrome blue fields, accumulations of identical objects, painted body prints

fluxus.grammar: a short written instruction performed as the artwork, humble everyday actions documented like event cards

conceptual-art.grammar: instructions, definitions and documentation stand in for the object, plain presentation with the idea foregrounded

arte-povera.grammar: rags, twigs, soil and scrap built monumental, raw unfinished surfaces with one flash of neon

capitalist-realism.grammar: photographs blurred into paintings, Ben-Day dot printing, chemical stains, advertising imagery quoted deadpan

neo-expressionism.grammar: big fast gestural paint, scrawled words and anatomy, crowned figures, thick urgent emotional surfaces

pictures-generation.grammar: appropriated advertisements and film stills re-presented, bold white-on-red text bars slashing black-and-white photographs

yba.grammar: specimens preserved in glass vitrines, grids of colored spots, shock subjects with slick clinical presentation

superflat.grammar: glossy depthless surfaces, cute cartoon characters, smiling flowers and jellyfish eyes swirling flat

lowbrow.grammar: big-eyed girls, tiki bars and hot rods from underground comix, painted with a glossy obsessive finish

contemporary-figuration.grammar: recognizable people in heroic poses against dense decorative pattern backgrounds that swallow the sitter

chicago-imagists.grammar: comic grotesque figures packed edge to edge, wiry line, circus-poster and shop-sign energy throughout

pattern-decoration.grammar: all-over ornament in layered repeats — tiles, florals, fabrics — until figure and pattern merge

neo-geo.grammar: day-glo geometric cells linked by conduits, circuit-board diagrams of society, cool hard edges

sots-art.grammar: heroic socialist-realist poster poses collided with Western brand logos, products and slogans

chinese-political-pop.grammar: propaganda heroes massed in poster layouts, stamped with brand logos, flat bars of commercial color

post-internet.grammar: stock photos, tilted screens and glossy 3D renders dragged into physical gallery objects and resin pools

vaporwave.grammar: Roman bust, palm trees, checkerboard floor and pastel grid sunset collaged into dreamy consumer nostalgia

glitch-art.grammar: corrupted files, compression smears and datamoshed pixels dissolving the image into digital breakage

cyberpunk.grammar: rain-slick neon megacity, steaming alleys, body technology and glowing contraband, high tech against low life

synthwave.grammar: chrome sun sinking over a glowing grid, purple mountains, VHS-cover and arcade-poster colors

steampunk.grammar: Victorian brass, gears, pipes and airships, goggles and clockwork standing in for computers

solarpunk.grammar: leafy terraces and solar glass, art-nouveau curves, gardens woven through bright green optimistic cities

y2k-aesthetic.grammar: liquid chrome blobs, frosted translucent plastic, iridescent bubbles and chunky pixel fonts

land-art.grammar: earthworks drawn at landscape scale, spirals of stone, artist tiny inside the work, weather collaborating

light-and-space.grammar: rooms of haze and colored light where edges dissolve and perception itself becomes the exhibit

brutalist-architecture.grammar: raw concrete masses, deep shadow-carved recesses, monumental fortress-like repetition of heavy forms

deconstructivist-architecture.grammar: fragmented titanium shards, tilted walls and colliding geometries frozen mid-explosion

kinetic-sculpture.grammar: balanced discs and rods rotating slowly on air currents, sculpture moving like slow weather

gutai.grammar: paint flung, poured and smashed through paper, raw material acting in performance across canvas

ballets-russes.grammar: exotic ornate stage sets drenched in color, painting, music and dance fused into total theatre

stop-motion.grammar: handmade clay, felt and miniature sets photographed frame by frame, maker's fingerprints left in the material

installation-kusama.grammar: mirrored rooms multiplying lights and reflections to infinity, polka dots covering every surface and form

performance-art.grammar: the artist's body performing a scored gesture before an audience, grainy documentation as the only remains

video-art.grammar: television sets stacked as sculpture — robots, walls, gardens — a face playing across every screen

assemblage.grammar: found objects — bottles, maps, toys, scraps — arranged inside shadow boxes until they dream

christo-wrapping.grammar: whole buildings and landscapes shrouded in fabric and rope, familiar landmarks turned soft and mysterious

process-art.grammar: materials left to sag, melt, scatter and rust on their own, gravity and chance as co-authors

mono-ha.grammar: raw stone, glass plate and beam placed in careful relation in near-empty space, arrangement as art

teamlab-immersive.grammar: projected waterfalls, flowers and fish filling dark rooms, images blooming across bodies and reacting to touch

modern-sculpture.grammar: the human figure reinvented: rough emotional bronze, polished egg-smooth forms, hollowed landscape-like reclining bodies

classic-animation.grammar: hand-drawn cels inked and laid over painted backgrounds, Technicolor warmth, slight shimmer at the cel edge

rubber-hose.grammar: boneless tube limbs bouncing to music, pie-cut eyes, a black-and-white world where everything wiggles

upa-limited.grammar: flat simple shapes and textured color fields, movement suggested rather than fully drawn, modernist design

silhouette-animation.grammar: jointed paper cut-outs filmed as pure black silhouettes against glowing colored backgrounds, shadow puppetry with a camera

rotoscope.grammar: live action traced frame by frame, uncannily smooth realistic motion wearing an illustrated skin

german-expressionist-cinema.grammar: crooked painted sets, jagged ink shadows on the walls, tilted streets inside a nightmare fairground

film-noir.grammar: venetian-blind light slicing faces into stripes, smoke and haze, wet streets shining behind the figure

noh-theatre.grammar: masked actors in glacial stillness on a bare stage with a single painted pine, fan in hand

kabuki.grammar: bold kumadori makeup, swirling costumes, dramatic mie poses frozen at emotional peaks along the runway

chinese-opera.grammar: painted-face color codes — red for loyalty, white for treachery — and water sleeves extending gesture into calligraphy
